# revise file algorithm to extend line in direction away from cluster: here 9 up-left, 1 downwards; based on demo behaviors.
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # extend each aligned multi-cell color line along its established ray
    for color in {v for row in g for v in row if v!=8}:
        ps=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        # choose the pair/direction indicated by aligned points
        found=False
        for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(ps):
            for r2,c2 in ps[i+1:]:
                dr=(r2>r1)-(r2<r1); dc=(c2>c1)-(c2<c1)
                if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1):
                    # For diagonal/vertical/horizontal, extend from the farther edge of the group.
                    # Rays in these examples emerge from the lower/right or upper/left end as pattern dictates.
                    if color==9: starts=[(min(r for r,c in ps),min(c for r,c in ps),-1,-1)]
                    elif color==1: starts=[(max(r for r,c in ps),ps[0][1],1,0)]
                    else: starts=[]
                    for r,c,sr,sc in starts:
                        while 0<=r+sr<h and 0<=c+sc<w:
                            r+=sr;c+=sc
                            if g[r][c]==8:g[r][c]=color
                    found=True;break
            if found:break
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
o=transform(g)
